title: कुलेले आत्महत्या गर्यो ? कथामा अनुभूतिको संरचना
nepali: प्रस्तुत अध्ययन नारायण ढकालद्वारा लिखित कुलेले आत्महत्या गर्यो कथामा वर्ग, पिँढी र प्रभुत्व एवम् दबाव र तनावबाट सिर्जित अनुभूतिको अध्ययनसँग सम्बन्धित छ । यसमा कथाले समेटेको कालगत सन्दर्भ, वर्ग, पिँढीगत दबाव र तनावका परिप्रेक्ष्यमा पात्रहरूले गरेका अनुभूति र दबाव र तनावका परिप्रेक्ष्यमा निर्मित विशिष्ट अनुभूतिको संरचना पहिल्याउने कार्य गरिएको छ । यस अध्ययनका लागि बेलायती समाजशास्त्री रेमन्ड विलियम्स (सन् १९२१–१९८८) को साहित्यको समाजशास्त्रीय मान्यताअनुभूतिको संरचना सम्बन्धी मान्यतालाई कृतिविश्लेषणको मुख्य आधारका रूपमा उपयोग गरिएको छ । अध्ययनको निष्कर्षमा कुलेले आत्महत्या गर्यो कथाले नेपाली समाजका राजनीतिक विकृति, बेरोजगार रआर्थिक अभावबाट पात्रहरूले गरेका विशिष्ट अनुभूतिका साथै दबाव र तनावबाट मुक्तिका लागि प्रतिरोधी चेतना विकसित भएर नयाँ उदीयमान संस्कृतिको जन्मको सङ्केत देखिएको निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: The present study is concerned with the study of experiences generated by class, generation, and hegemony, as well as pressure and tension, in the story "Kulele Aatmahatya Garyo" (Did Kule Commit Suicide?) written by Narayan Dhakal. In this, work has been done to identify the experiences undergone by characters from the perspectives of temporal context, class, and generational pressure and tension encompassed by the story, alongside the distinct structure of feeling constructed from the perspectives of pressure and tension. For this study, the sociological perspective on literature of British sociologist Raymond Williams (1921–1988), specifically his theoretical concept regarding the structure of feeling, is utilized as the primary foundation for analyzing the work. In the conclusion of the study, it is concluded that the story "Kulele Aatmahatya Garyo" reflects the distinct experiences undergone by characters stemming from the political anomalies, unemployment, and economic deprivation of Nepali society, while also signaling the emergence of a new rising culture through the development of resistant consciousness aimed at liberation from pressure and tension.

informal_english: This study looks at the experiences shaped by class, generation, hegemony, and the everyday pressure and stress in Narayan Dhakal's story "Kulele Aatmahatya Garyo" (Did Kule Commit Suicide?). Here, the job is to suss out the experiences the characters go through in terms of the story's time period, class, and generational pressure and strain, together with the distinct structure of feeling built up under that pressure and stress. For this study, British sociologist Raymond Williams' (1921–1988) sociological take on literature, particularly his concept of the structure of feeling, is used as the main basis for pulling apart and analysing the work. Wrapping up, the study reckons the story "Kulele Aatmahatya Garyo" shows the distinct experiences characters have from the political mess, unemployment, and lack of money in Nepali society, while also signalling the birth of a fresh emerging culture as people develop a resistant mindset to break free from pressure and stress.
translator_notes: Strict 4-sentence order maintained across all versions. The critical cultural studies term 'अनुभूतिको संरचना' is rendered as Raymond Williams' standard theoretical concept 'structure of feeling'. Informal flavour: New Zealand casual.
